topics.text: Situated in a scenic, tranquil area with nearby tea plantations, bamboo forests, and hiking trails. Many reviews highlight the "mountain view," "fresh air," and proximity to Morandi Mountain.
Rooms are clean, spacious, and well-maintained, often featuring minimalist designs, tatami rooms, and views of the surrounding landscape.
The on-site "yacht club" is frequently praised for its thrill and uniqueness, described as "excellent" and "unparalleled."
Staff are consistently described as "friendly," "attentive," and "helpful," with some noting the availability of local guides or activity arrangements.
Includes a game room , outdoor pool, and mountain hiking trails.

address: Mei'er Village Group, Ziling Village (near Naked Castle), Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 假期出行預訂了這家民宿，三天兩晚體驗感很棒！房間陽台的視野很好，可以看到遠處的羣山竹海，也可以看到近處的田園野趣。四樓的天台可以吹到林間清風。一樓大廳有各種娛樂設施:茶室、麻將桌、桌球桌、K歌設備、遊戲機…還摸到了他家閑逛的小貓咪🐱酒店附近就有茶園。
comments.author: Anonymous User

comments.quote: 藏於莫干山竹海間，環境清幽雅緻，房間乾淨舒適。管家服務貼心周到，餐食地道美味。遠離喧囂，治癒身心，是度假放鬆的絕佳選擇，下次還來！
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 這次入住體驗超棒！晚上到店特別晚，沒想到管家不僅提前幫忙打開了空調並且全程熱情接待幫拿行李，細緻講解入住事宜，貼心又周到，瞬間讓人感覺特別温暖。早起在周圍散步呼吸新鮮空氣，茶園小路和竹林泛起清晨的薄霧。民宿環境整潔，細節處滿是用心，整體體驗感拉滿，還在管家推薦下，從小路上了莫干山，風景非常美，真心推薦給大家，下次還來～
comments.author: Guest User
